# dayloop v0.12.0-rc3 — task workflow review build

This prerelease is an installable candidate for checking the revised Today, full-day, Calendar, and P5R walkthrough experience on a real device.

## What changed since rc2

- Replaced the P5R Done slash with a conventional text strikethrough.
- Extended the readable hold for both the Day Complete transition and perfect-day card; both remain skippable.
- Removed the Calendar, full-day, and Achievements shortcut links from Today.
- Restyled Undo day and pinned it beside End day at the bottom of Today.
- Renamed the visible walkthrough list to Tasks, added a Check all command, and grouped all P5R tasks under source-backed Day and Night headings.
- Added the guide's month-end achievement checklists to Today and full-day pages, synchronized with the Achievements tab.
- Made the Today banner inherit the date display face and show the current date after its in-page header scrolls out of view.
- Pinned the previous/next authored-day controls to the bottom of full-day pages.
- Abbreviated Calendar month headings and made each monthly achievement directly checkable.
- Audited the P5R walkthrough against Alyookid's Date / Day / Night schedule without copying its prose into the pack.

## What to check

- Mark individual tasks Done and confirm only their text is struck through; Skip and Later keep their existing treatments.
- Complete a day and confirm there is enough time to read the completion treatment, or tap it to dismiss early.
- Scroll short and long Today pages: the bottom commands should remain pinned and the formatted date should transfer to the banner only after the date header is no longer visible.
- Confirm Check all marks every task Done without clearing tasks that were already Done.
- Inspect dates with both Day and Night groups, especially April 9, April 17, and November 18.
- On the final authored date of a month, check an achievement and confirm the same state appears in Calendar and Achievements.
- Browse full-day pages with the pinned previous/next controls and verify content is not obscured behind them.
- Browse Calendar months and confirm headings use three-letter month names.

## Candidate APK notes

- This APK is **not production-signed**. It uses Android's standard debug signing key for hands-on testing.
- Its application id is `com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`, so it can be installed alongside the production Dayloop app.
- Its profiles, progress, and settings are separate from the stable app.
- Version: `0.12.0-rc3` (`versionCode 16`).

_Fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA._
